'''RAFO''' is the common acronym used for saying '''Read and Find Out'''. It is used with the implication that the particular question or plot-line for what one wants the answer to, will be revealed in the next, or in a future, book. It is most commonly used for a literary series. The equivalent for the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]] series is {{TVlink|WAFO}} (Watch and Find Out).

{{quote|Read And Find Out. I have grown so used to that answer, that when my wife asks me if I want to go out for dinner this evening, I sometimes say "Read and find out." That's usually when she hits me.|Robert Jordan, [[Source:Scifi.com chat, 1 November 1998]]}}
